name: echowave-stream-deck
description: EchoWave: visual Stream Deck checks for ICMP echo and HTTP/HTTPS services on Windows.

scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run smoke && npm run verify:public
scripts.link: npm run build && npm run smoke && streamdeck dev && streamdeck link com.devdael.echowave.sdPlugin
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run smoke && streamdeck restart com.devdael.echowave
scripts.package:public: npm run validate && node ./scripts/require-release-artwork.mjs && streamdeck pack --force com.devdael.echowave.sdPlugin
